data.qc_scope: all 69 channels per time row; explicit quarantine, never a proof of corruption
data.missing_input: all arms NO_FORECAST; no labels from this issue
data.missing_truth: cell mask at scoring; invalid feedback never released before or after availability
data.missing_arm_feature: F0 fallback counted and scored; no date substitution
data.calibration_replacement: none; missing registered calibration issue is BLOCKED, not silent shrinking

clock.fresh_issue: t-1 calendar day, never latest surviving issue
clock.actual_available: max(nominal label availability, dependent fitted artifact availability); offline calibration is not online publication
clock.decay_age: t - raw_label_available, not artifact build time or usable_after
clock.offline_calibration_context: estimate artifacts may be retrospective; per-issue raw feedback labels must satisfy label_available<=t; never publish these fit scores as historical online forecasts
clock.bundle_variables: all six scoring variables at steps 1,2,3,4
clock.ocl_label_lineage: must contain every raw supervision id used by lag1/lag1c at same cutoff
clock.preanalysis_state: replay released F0 records only; no retroactive corrected forecasts before artifact availability

metrics.weights: cos(latitude) broadcast to H*W and normalized to sum 1 on declared regular global cell-center grid
metrics.difference_pp: I_a-I_b with the same F0 denominator
metrics.selection_loss: mean of physical MSE/D_est over 6 variables x steps 1,4,12,20
metrics.gradient_loss: mean of physical MSE/D_est_short over 6 variables x steps 1,2,3,4
metrics.denominator: D_est is pooled F0 physical MSE (RMSE squared), estimate-period only and versioned

arms.mean_gradient: arithmetic mean of raw FP32 gradients over estimate target rows; accumulate FP64; freeze permanently
arms.delay30: -unit(g[t-30days]-g_mean_est); calendar exact; same centering as primary; replaces random

calibration.zero_direction_policy: include zero-response cases in registered median; if every registered direction is zero, freeze entire family F0-equivalent with amplitude=0,multiplier=1; do not remove zero cases
calibration.formula: sqrt(sum(w*(edited_norm-f0_norm)^2)/sum(w*(f0_norm-truth_norm)^2)) per issue; all 69 state-normalized channels; median across registered issues

selection.ridge_sklearn_alpha: n_train * ridge_lambda after estimate-only feature scaling
selection.tie: within 1e-12 normalized selection loss, choose the first in declared grid order
selection.final_output_refit: estimate+select target rows only, gap excluded; artifacts available no earlier than 2020-03-31T00:00:00Z

inference.implementation: numpy circular weekly-block resampling; no arch requirement
inference.week_anchor: 2020-03-30T00:00:00Z (Monday); include partial first/last and empty weeks
inference.paired_statistics: weekly sum MSE and valid counts; shared indices for all arms/cells; no compression of empty weeks
inference.interval: two-sided Bonferroni percentile per frozen family; optional pre-calibrated uniform width multiplier

positive_mse_generator.ar: phi=sqrt(rho); Z_t=phi*Z_(t-1)+sqrt(1-phi^2)*epsilon_t; initialize with mean 0, marginal variance 1 and the same equicorrelation; 4096 burn-in days
positive_mse_generator.rho_interpretation: rho targets stationary squared-error daily autocorrelation without drift, not latent residual autocorrelation; report measured simulation autocorrelation with Monte Carlo error
positive_mse_generator.innovation_covariance: exchangeable correlation 0.5 across the full arm x cell vector; multivariate t5 standardized to marginal variance 1
positive_mse_generator.population_truth: pool D_est[c]*r[a]*(1.05+d[t]^2) over the fixed valid dates, then apply the same RMSE ratios/differences
positive_mse_generator.restriction: do not exponentiate t innovations: the resulting positive loss need not have a finite mean; do not claim these toy scenarios cover all real dependence

coverage_calibration.choose_factor: smallest common factor passing every family/scenario on calibration simulations; independent validation once, no escalation after failure
coverage_calibration.pass_rule: each family/scenario empirical simultaneous coverage >=0.95 and Wilson95 lower >=0.93
coverage_calibration.on_failure: STATISTICAL_INCONCLUSIVE; no formal Gate or automatic analysis run
coverage_calibration.claim_limit: simulation assurance only; no guaranteed real-sequence coverage

mde.source: fit residual/cell paired influence series; centered null; selection split sensitivity
mde.required: table for all families, complete Gate conjunction power and CI half-width; Monte Carlo uncertainty
mde.criterion: MDE is the smallest true effect whose simulated lower bound exceeds the already fixed comparator threshold in >=80% replicates
mde.on_low_power: retain thresholds; descriptive run only with explicit signature or statistical INCONCLUSIVE

inference.robustness: if 7/28-day diagnostics support an opposite directional claim, flag INCONCLUSIVE; never select the most favorable block length

gate.G_B: all primary cells: L(I_lag1c)>0; L(I_lag1c-I_static)>0.3; L(I_lag1c-I_ewma_g)>0.3; L(I_lag1c-I_delay30)>0
gate.G_C: all primary cells and b in [dabc,ocl_fresh,obc]: L(I_lag1c-I_b)>0
gate.three_state: threshold q: PASS iff L>q, NOT_MET iff U<=q, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
gate.GO: engineering+data+coverage gates pass AND G_B,G_C,G_H all PASS; human Gate1 and A5 still required
gate.inconclusive_followup: only same frozen configuration on preregistered 2021 replication under separate A7 and GPU approval; no 2020 expansion or threshold changes
gate.null_claim: CI crossing zero is not absence of effect or proof of only slow drift
gate.threshold_status: proposed and written before new pilot; human signature still MISSING

budget.units: allocated H100 card-hours including failed/startup/preempted jobs
budget.measurement: t_roll20,t_roll4,t_grad4,t_grad2,io/startup; synchronize CUDA; report p50 and p95
budget.timing_dates: first 8 calendar-ordered eligible estimate issues after signed QC; record exact dates before timing
budget.formula_basis: one worker/GPU per issue; allocated idle multi-GPU time also charged; warmup states do not require parameter forecasts
budget.unmeasured_estimate: 2-3 card-hours is a review estimate, not a measurement or allocation

diagnostics.truth_one_step: 39 preregistered issues only; nondeployable, not an upper bound
diagnostics.buf12: steps1,2 paired with no buffer; 2 runs; same released labels at daily 00Z
diagnostics.lag2: reuse existing day-2 gradient, no recomputation

retired.legacy_headroom: retired from current scope; incomplete, not scientific falsification
